content: Working on src/middleware/auth.ts with a Redis token bucket.
Redis token bucket failed in src/middleware/auth.ts staging.
The connection pool exhausted and we had to abort the Redis limiter.
Never log Authorization headers in src/middleware/auth.ts. Do not retry Redis.
We decided to use jose, not jsonwebtoken, for Edge.
The limiter stays in-process in src/middleware/auth.ts instead of Redis.
